picks.thesis: The bear call spread offers a high credit‑to‑width of 0.30 (credit 0.30 for a 1‑point width) with a short call delta of +0.3049, giving a generous premium while staying close to the 0.25‑0.35 delta band. IV on the short leg is 0.1817, indicating reasonable pricing for the one‑day horizon.

The bull put spread provides a solid credit‑to‑width of 0.26 (credit 0.26 for a 1‑point width) and a short put delta of –0.3143, placing it near the optimal delta range for a short put. IV is 0.1989, offering a good premium relative to risk for the same one‑day expiry.
